_bossComment: The Bosses page. Defaults are VANILLA: the server rolls each map's own BossChance once per raid, seeded from the raid id (emu/raid.rollBossSpawnList). Before this existed nothing read BossChance at all and every boss in a map's BossLocationSpawn spawned every raid -- one live Woods raid produced Shturman, the Goons, Partisan and the Cultists together, which the data puts at 0.07%.
_stagedStartComment: Staged raid start. OFF = the table this emulator always served (12 waves at Time:-1, 40 bots, every rolled boss immediate). ON = same waves, same bots, but at most stagedStartInitialBots stay on the synchronous arm; the rest land from stagedStartFirstDelaySec on, immediate bosses get stagedStartBossDelaySec, and the map's own BotStart is restored. Measured why: docs/MOD-PERF.md.
_lootComment: The Loot page. Every default below is the behaviour this emulator shipped with, so an untouched config generates the same floor it always did -- emu/loot.selfCheck asserts exactly that ('every new knob at its default reproduces the previous floor EXACTLY'). lootPreset is MOMENTARY (it writes the rows below and the page then shows what it wrote) and lootSummary is written BY the server, the same way spawnNow/spawnResult work. Docs: docs/LOOT-CONFIG.md.
_lootWeightComment: The 22 family weights below multiply the pool weight of every item whose _parent chain reaches that base class. Every base-class id was READ OUT OF THIS INSTALL'S db.json on 2026-08-31 (tools/bigjson.py get --path templates.items.<id>._name) rather than taken from a community list; one candidate that did not resolve was dropped instead of shipped. 1.0 emits no entry at all, so an untouched page skips the shaping pass entirely. See emu/loot.CategoryWeightIds for the id next to each name.
_moneyComment: The currency mix and the stack range. MEASURED off this install's db.json: Rubles 5449016a4bdc2d6f028b456f spawn 5500..13500 (cap 1000000), Dollars 5696686a4bdc2da3298b456a 45..100 (cap 50000), Euro 569668774bdc2da2298b4568 35..90 (cap 50000); all three have _parent 543be5dd4bdc2deb348b4569 (Money). The three moneyStack* keys are read by BOTH generators -- emu/loot's world stack roller and emu/bots.randomStackCount, which is where the single-dollar drop was fixed -- through the shared emu/knobs.moneyStackConfig, so one row governs money on the floor and money in a scav's pocket.
_botGearComment: The Bots > Gear and Bots > Loot pages. Every row is a MULTIPLIER ON THE DATABASE'S OWN NUMBER (bots.types.<role>.chances / .generation) -- none of them invents a chance where the table gave none, and at 1.0 emu/botgear.scalePercent returns its input with no arithmetic, so an untouched page reproduces the previous bot roll for roll. The nine families classify all 57 role keys read out of db.json on 2026-08-31; a role matching none of them lands in Other, which has its own pair of rows, so no role is silently ungoverned. Pockets and SecuredContainer deliberately have NO row: emu/bots.addLoadout documents that the client dereferences Equipment.Slots[8] unconditionally and a pocketless bot takes the raid activation down with it.
_svmComment: The SVM/profile-manager rows that are NOT globals.config (emu/svm). The 770 globals rows -- stamina, inertia, malfunction, overheat, armour, flea, exp tables, skills -- are declared programmatically from emu/globaltunedata and are absent from this file ON PURPOSE: an untouched key means no override and no reparse of the 694 KB globals document. stashResult and raidTuneResult are written BY the server, like spawnResult and mapsLockResult.
_menuCornerLabel: Profile Name | PVE ZONE | No text. The literal key name is also this feature's deploy marker (tools/deploy.json) -- do not rename it without moving the marker.
_mapsComment: Which maps the player may load into. Writes locations.<map>.base.Locked, which /client/locations sends verbatim; Enabled is deliberately NOT written (BSG's own reply for this build carries Enabled=false on 9 of 24 maps as its own axis). Map names in the two lists may be spelled any way -- database key (bigmap), client Id (Woods, RezervBase) or _Id GUID -- because they go through emu/raid.canonicalLocation; only 4 of 19 maps spell key and Id alike. mapsLockResult is written BY the server after each apply and names any map that resolved to nothing.
_spawnComment: The Spawn Items row group. spawnNow is MOMENTARY -- onTarkovSettings intercepts the POST, runs the spawn and writes the key back to false -- and spawnResult is written BY the server, not by the player. They are still ordinary persisted keys, which is what lets the page render the last outcome after a reload; they are listed here so that no declared setting is missing a path (tools/settingscheck.py).
//orbitQuestPoi: Merge mods/waypoints' patrol geometry (8,556 hand-authored, on-navmesh points across 10 maps) into ORBIT's anchor catalogue as questPoi anchors. These are the only anchors whose coordinates were authored on the navmesh rather than being the centroid of a grid cell. Set false to use the spawn layers only.
//orbitQuestAnchors: How many questPoi anchors the quest layer may claim out of the 24-anchor budget. The layer runs LAST, so it fills what the loot and spawn layers left.
//orbitQuestBias: How much a questPoi anchor outweighs the best spawn-derived anchor AFTER the quest layer is rescaled onto the same scale. 1.0 means no preference. Not a raw multiplier: the layers count different things (patrol points per cell run to the hundreds, spawn points to single digits) so a raw multiplier would be a takeover, not a preference.
